about_the_game:
State of Affairs - A Modern Geopolitical Simulation

Step into the role of a nation’s leader in State of Affairs, a turn-based political strategy game where history is yours to shape. Navigate the complex realities of governance in the 20th and 21st centuries, balancing domestic and international pressures as you build your legacy.

Available Scenarios

  • Japan: Post-WWII Recovery (1952)
    Rebuild a nation rising from the ashes of war. Will you embrace democratic reforms and align with the West, or restore imperial traditions and reclaim your place as a regional power? Modernize the economy, navigate growing international pressure, and balance the competing forces of progress and tradition. The path you choose will shape Japan's future for generations to come.

  • USSR: After Stalin (1953)
    Take control of the Soviet Union at a pivotal crossroads in history. Will you preserve Stalin's legacy of centralized power and military dominance, or embrace de-Stalinization and chart a new course for the future? Navigate the treacherous path of economic modernization while maintaining your grip on global influence during the height of the Cold War. The fate of the Soviet empire hangs in the balance.

  • USA: Post-War Prosperity (1955)
    Lead the United States through an era of unprecedented prosperity and social upheaval. Will you champion civil rights and embrace progress, or preserve the status quo to maintain stability? Balance economic growth, societal transformation, and Cold War rivalries as you shape the future of American democracy. The American Dream is yours to redefine.

Key Features

  • Immersive Scenarios: Step into defining moments in history, each with its own unique challenges, political landscape, and strategic goals. Your choices will shape the course of your nation’s future.

  • Realistic Political Simulation: Manage legislative bodies, balance factional tensions, and respond to voter demands. Build coalitions, negotiate compromises, and navigate the complexities of governance.

  • Dynamic Crises and Policies: Respond to protests, scandals, and geopolitical disputes, or implement bold reforms to leave your mark.

  • Deep Replayability: With countless paths to success or failure, each decision shapes a story that’s uniquely yours.

A Commitment to Realism

At the heart of State of Affairs lies a dedication to realism, offering players a nuanced simulation of economics, social behavior, and politics. Our systems are designed to reflect the intricate interplay of governance, economics, and societal trends, ensuring that every decision has meaningful consequences.

  • Authentic Political Landscape: Engage with governing bodies and factions that behave based on ideology, vested interests, and relationships with the player. Navigate the push-and-pull of coalition politics, negotiate compromises, and manage dissent to maintain stability.

  • Dynamic Social Behaviors: Citizens and voter groups are influenced by real-world factors, such as cultural trends, social movements, and economic changes. These groups evolve over time, presenting new challenges and opportunities for leadership.

  • Realistic Economic Systems: From budgeting and taxation to trade and industry, every aspect of your nation’s economy responds dynamically to your policies and external pressures. Manage resources wisely to ensure growth while balancing debt, inflation, and public satisfaction.

  • Complex Decision-Making: No decision is made in isolation. Whether adjusting a tax rate or passing landmark legislation, every choice affects the economy, society, and your nation’s political future in interconnected ways.

Repeat History or Forge a New Path

Will you uphold the status quo, adhering to historical decisions that brought stability and progress, or take bold risks to alter the course of your nation’s destiny? Every choice you make influences the political landscape, reshapes the economy, and redefines the social fabric of your country.

History provides the foundation, but the future is yours to write. In State of Affairs, you’re not just a spectator to the past: you’re an active participant, capable of repeating history as it was or forging a legacy that’s entirely your own.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
